title: Medical kit inventory
notice: Representative training inventory, not the real ISS kit. Grouped by the ISS Crew Health Care System (CHeCS) pack names from public NASA sources (2011/2015), plus the emergency equipment; contents not confirmed for 2026. Devices and supplies; the medicine packs are left out.
